QUOTE: "staleness is measured per reply, and an unreadable database or failed measurement degrades to \"no annotation\" rather than an error. A query can therefore return with no warning when the check itself failed. The code is written to prefer that over turning a good answer into an error"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly states that a failed staleness measurement degrades to no annotation rather than turning a good reply into an error.
